thread:
maria: Heads up \/ FYI \/ decision point: Compliance wants us to shorten non-sensitive app-debug log retention to 90 days. Before I change SIEM exports, want to check forensic\/vuln-triage risks.
alex: Which exact streams are you calling non-sensitive? app-debug vs request-traces vs metrics?
maria: Plan: app-debug + feature-flags + client-side non-auth traces -> 90d. Auth events, infra\/syslog, sec-alerts -> keep 365d.
devon: That split seems fine generally. Caveat: some request traces include headers\/payloads with PII or token fragments. Need scrub pipeline or classify traces more conservatively.
samir: Operational concern: if we expire debug after 90d, how do we handle investigations requiring >90d data? We need a Just-In-Time (JIT) unseal\/escrow flow for preserved evidence.
maria: My draft flow: 1) SIEM retention 90d 2) lifecycle moves older objects to cold S3 encrypted with dedicated KMS key (alias\/reds:escrow) 3) objects expire after 365d in cold storage 4) JIT unseal via ticket + approvers for retrieval. Thoughts?
alex: I like it. Concrete controls: - KMS key with strict key policy limiting Decrypt to a JIT role - assume-role flow uses MFA + approval check - all decrypts logged to audit service.
devon: Suggest we make evidence snapshots per-incident rather than ad-hoc unseals. For high-sev incidents, ops creates an escrow snapshot that's bound to the incident ID and retention extended to 1yr, otherwise default 365d.
ops-bot: lifecycle-job scheduled nightly (archive-debug -> cold-bucket) next run 2026-04-02T03:00Z.
samir: From vuln triage: stack traces and related traces can be critical >90d. We should keep a minimal indexed trace for 1yr (like trace IDs and metadata) and stash full payloads in escrow for on-demand restore. That lets search and correlation work without keeping everything hot.
tay: Partners that consume SIEM exports: need notification window. They may rely on long-retention analytics. We should publish migration\/export options and a grace period.
maria: Actionable checklist I'm thinking: 1) update S3 lifecycle rules 2) create escrow KMS key & key-policy 3) create JIT IAM role + approval playbook 4) partner communication + export tool 5) forensic dry-run and SLAs 6) cost estimate.
alex: Add monitoring: alert if archive-job fails >24h and periodic restore drills (SLA: restore sample within 1h). Also validate that KMS Alias rotation plan exists and owner assigned.
devon: Example snippets to include in RFC: lifecycle and a minimal KMS policy (MFA + role).
```# s3-lifecycle-example (YAML)
rules:
  - id: move-debug-to-cold
    prefix: "app-debug/"
    status: Enabled
    transition:
      - days: 90
        storage_class: GLACIER
  - id: expire-debug
    prefix: "app-debug/"
    status: Enabled
    expiration:
      days: 365
```
```# kms-policy (JSON)
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowJITDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/forensics-temp-unseal"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
ops-bot: retention-change draft ticket created: SEC-5234-draft (link placeholder).
samir: For the JIT approval flow, require ticket with incident ID + two approvers (oncall + eng lead) and automated audit: KMS decrypt, S3 access, and copy operations recorded. Revoke role after 4 hours automatically.
tay: Partners team note: add an export API that lets partners request a one-time historical export for a defined window before the retention drop. We should log and rate-limit exports.
maria: I'll write RFC and include owners & timeline. I'll also add a short SLA blurb: Standard forensic restore: 4 hours for single object, 24 hours for bulk request (TBD).
devon: Don't forget runbook updates and a dry-run: create test incident SEC-TEST-0001, run JIT unseal, verify artifact integrity and that audit entries are present.
alex: Also include a regression test: try to restore a sample object and verify the trace chain can be reconstructed within target time.
maria: Ok, opening RFC now and will ping ops oncall when ready. Thanks all :pray:
tay: :thumbsup: add integrations team to RFC for partner impact.
samir: +1 on evidence-scoped snapshots per-incident. Keeps overall retention low but preserves what we need for root cause.
maria: Great. I'll paste the RFC link when ready. If anyone wants to drop more IAM or playbook text, paste here and I'll include it.
